hero.title: Privacy Policy And Sales Terms.
hero.copy: How Midland Commercials collects, uses and protects your personal data under UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018.

controller.heading: Who We Are
controller.intro: Midland Commercials is the data controller for personal data collected through this website. If you have any question about this policy or your data, contact us using the details below.
controller.companyNumber: Company number: {{value}} (registered in England and Wales)

sections.heading: What We Collect
paragraphs: We only collect what we need to answer your enquiry and sell you a vehicle:
items: Contact details: your name, phone number and email address.
Enquiry details: the vehicle you are interested in, your requirements and any notes you send.
Part exchange details: your vehicle registration, mileage, condition notes and photos you share with us.
Stock alert preferences: the type of vehicle you want us to tell you about.
Chat messages you send through the website assistant.
Technical data: your IP address and browser details in server logs, kept for security.
Analytics and advertising data, only if you accept those cookies.

sections.heading: How We Use It And Our Legal Basis
paragraphs: UK GDPR requires a legal basis for each use of your data. Ours are:
items: Answering enquiries, arranging viewings and valuing part exchanges: to take steps at your request before entering a contract, and our legitimate interest in running the business.
Completing a sale and keeping sales records: performance of a contract and our legal obligations (for example HMRC and VAT records).
Stock alerts and marketing messages: your consent, which you can withdraw at any time.
Website security and fraud prevention: our legitimate interest in keeping the site and your data safe.
Analytics and advertising cookies: your consent, given through the cookie banner.

sections.heading: Who We Share It With
paragraphs: We never sell your data. We only share it with service providers who help us run the website, under contracts that require them to protect it:
items: Our website hosting and database provider, which stores enquiry data on secure servers.
Google (Google Analytics and Google Ads), only if you accept analytics or marketing cookies.
Meta Platforms (Meta Pixel), only if you accept marketing cookies.
Unsplash, which serves some website images and receives your IP address when they load.
DVLA and DVSA, when we check a vehicle registration you send us for a part exchange.
Professional advisers, finance and law enforcement bodies, only where the law requires it.

sections.heading: International Transfers
paragraphs: Some providers, such as Google and Meta, may process data outside the UK. Where they do, the transfer is protected by the UK International Data Transfer Agreement, the UK Extension to the EU-US Data Privacy Framework or another safeguard approved under UK law.

sections.heading: How Long We Keep It
items: Enquiries, chat messages and part exchange details: up to 24 months from your last contact with us, then deleted.
Sales records and invoices: 6 years after the end of the financial year, as required by HMRC.
Stock alert and marketing preferences: until you unsubscribe or ask us to stop.
Server security logs: up to 90 days.
Cookie choices: stored in your browser for up to 12 months.

sections.heading: Your Rights
paragraphs: Under UK GDPR you have the right to:
items: Access the personal data we hold about you.
Ask us to correct data that is wrong or incomplete.
Ask us to delete your data.
Ask us to restrict or stop using your data, or object to how we use it.
Receive your data in a portable format.
Withdraw your consent at any time, without affecting earlier use.
after: To use any of these rights, email {{email}}. We will reply within one month and there is no charge.

If you are unhappy with how we handle your data, you can complain to the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) at ico.org.uk or on 0303 123 1113. We would appreciate the chance to put things right first.

sections.heading: Cookies
paragraphs: Essential cookies and browser storage keep the website working and remember your cookie choice. Analytics and marketing cookies (Google Analytics, Google Ads and the Meta Pixel) are only set if you accept them. You can change your choice at any time using the Cookie Settings link at the bottom of every page.

sections.heading: Keeping Your Data Secure
paragraphs: Data is sent over an encrypted HTTPS connection and stored on access-controlled servers. Only authorised Midland Commercials staff can see enquiries, and every admin action is logged.

sections.heading: Vehicle Information
paragraphs: Listings are prepared in good faith from available stock information. Buyers should confirm final specification, VAT status, MOT, condition, mileage, Clean Air Zone suitability and availability before purchase.

sections.heading: Reservation And Payment Terms
paragraphs: This website does not take online payments. Deposits, reservations, part exchange values, the full price, taxes and cancellation terms are confirmed directly with the sales team before a sale is completed.

sections.heading: Changes To This Policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top of this page shows when it was last changed.

faqs.question: Can I Reserve A Truck Remotely?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can share extra photos, arrange a video walkaround and hold the truck after final availability checks and an agreed deposit.

faqs.question: Can I View A Truck Before I Buy?
faqs.answer: Yes. Viewings are by appointment at our yard in Little Wigston, Swadlincote, DE12 7BJ, so the truck and its paperwork are ready when you arrive.

faqs.question: Can I Part Exchange My Vehicle?
faqs.answer: Yes. Send the registration, mileage, condition notes and photos so the team can prepare a valuation.

faqs.question: Do Prices Include VAT?
faqs.answer: Each listing shows whether the price is plus VAT, VAT included or no VAT. Final VAT status is confirmed on the invoice before payment.

faqs.question: Do You Show MOT And Clean Air Zone Information?
faqs.answer: Listings include MOT status and Euro/CAZ notes where available. Buyers should still check registration-specific details before use.
